labels.kw: critical load of a health site: the SEforALL Type 2 PHC priority-1 loads (delivery room, oxygen, interior lights), peak 0.55 kW, 4.73 kWh/day; an archetype, not measured per facility; the vaccine fridge is a separate PQS system

properties.name: Yola market (OSM name 'Market')
properties.supply: Yola North LGA band mixture (NERC rows naming places in the LGA, as for health); no feeder match

labels.load: one ColdHubs-type room per market (about 3 t, 150 crates, 5.5 kWp; VERIFIED_SECONDARY); no kWh/day is published, so the load is DERIVED as the array's mean daily yield here, 24.1 kWh/day (23.9 to 24.4 over the weather years), 24 h
labels.lga: LGA of the nearest health facility

properties.rank_rule: city plan order: critical service-hours gained in a 60-day outage (with the plan minus today), most first; ties by lower capex, then site id. Sites already powered on site (UMTH) are not ranked
properties.facility_id: the GRID3 unique_id for health sites (the id /api/facilities takes); null for other sectors
